title: 🌅 Witnessing Light Break Into Darkness
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment…
Standing at the edge of nothing. Silence pressing in from every direction. The deep is unformed, shadowed, endless.
Not chaos. Not confusion. Just light breaking in. Warm against the cool dark. Gentle, yet unstoppable.
I am a witness, not a biblical character… but I feel the shift. Darkness doesn’t argue. It simply retreats.
Maybe that’s what a new beginning looks like. Not everything fixed at once. Just one beam of clarity cutting through confusion. One spark of hope interrupting the night.
“And God said, ‘Let there be light,’ and there was light.”
What if your fresh start doesn’t need to be loud… just illuminated?
💭 Share what this moment makes you feel.
